messages:
Noah: Slightly silly poll: you get one physical "Do-Over" token that pauses a single tiny but recurring annoyance for exactly 1 hour. What do you pause? (keep answers short)
Rina: Stalled laundry cycle alerts. The dryer never tells the truth. :woman-shrugging: 
Chris: Notification badges. Blink out my phone corner for an hour. :iphone:
Ava: The endless 'are you still there?' streaming prompts. Let me watch in peace. :tv:
Noah: Love the picks. Would you rather get one token per month or one lifetime token?
Rina: Monthly. Tiny wins add up.
Chris: Lifetime. Save it for a catastrophic day.
Ava: Monthly. Also tradeable? :eyes:
CalendarBot: Tip: schedule "focus hours" to auto-snooze notifications. This is not a token. :calendar:
Noah: Bonus quick round: what color is the token? Single word.
Rina: Mint
Chris: Gunmetal
Ava: Neon
Noah: Vote time — reply with "monthly" or "lifetime"
Rina: monthly
Chris: lifetime
Ava: monthly
Noah: Tally so far: 2 monthly, 1 lifetime. Thanks y'all, this brightened my coffee break. :sparkles:
